About.title: ABOUT RADER
About.subtitle: An ecosystem serving sustainable development
About.text: The RADER Group brings together RADER SA and its subsidiary GLOBTOURNET, a pan-African group deploying innovative solutions in agriculture, agri-food, water, environment, energy, real estate and digital technology, for inclusive and sustainable growth...

cards.question: Are you a graduate who is unemployed or working in the informal sector? Do you want to become a distributor of RADER SA or GLOBTOURNET SA products and services in your municipality?
cards.cta: Contact us for an installation loan

cards.cta: Contact us for an eco-responsible production and consumption loan

cards.question: Are you a B2B buyer (supermarket, bayam-sellam association, butchers' association, agro-pastoral exporter, etc.) who wants to secure your supply chain and work towards carbon neutrality?
cards.cta: Contact us for our contract farming services

cards.question: Do you own a community or municipal forest?
cards.cta: Contact us for our reforestation (paid/avoided) and satellite monitoring services

cards.question: Are you a university? Do you want access to quality educational content to promote Education for Sustainable Development (ESD)?
